name: Campelles (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with a yellow sword in pale between two yellow horseshoes.
history: The flag was approved on 25 April 2001 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3386 of 11 May 2001; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, green, with a yellow sword 12/14 of the height centred in the second vertical third and two yellow horseshoes 3/14 of the height.

features.role: sword in pale, 12/14 of the height, between two horseshoes
